educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn about classical Japanese literature (e.g., narrative, verse, story, chronicles of war). (2) Improve their reading comprehension skills by reading Japanese literature. (3) Learn about “Japanese language expression” and improve their ability to think.
advice: This basic course on Japanese literature will cover the following: 1. Reading classical Japanese literature 2. Composing waka (“Japanese poetry”) 3. Writing critical essays and letters Students are required to participate actively in class. Students are expected to bring their textbooks, handouts, and other necessary materials to every class. Students are expected to learn proper citation methods. Students are expected to think about their own life through reading classical Japanese literature. Students are expected to write some waka. Students are expected to check for message/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
